owner: LLD-04 supplies typed import/review state; LLD-10 owns frontend components, interaction mechanics and presentation composition.
source_surfaces: Advanced Search SR inbox status uses advanced_search_import_directory with Configure, Check now and Select file actions.
RFC and WFM use the shared rfc_wfm_import_directory but remain distinct source families with separate Check now and Select file actions.
Advanced Search never silently reuses the RFC/WFM directory and RFC/WFM never silently reuse the Advanced Search inbox.
latest source checkpoint and last run status show source-family chronology explicitly as import/source ordering rather than business lifecycle time
run_summary: exact observed rows and valid identities
review_groups: SR Customer/Customer Contact/Current Handler reference candidates
advanced_search_state: Current Handler text remains source-owned display evidence; a reviewed current_handler_reference is shown separately and never rewrites source text.
Customer and Contact ambiguity is explicit and does not block independently valid SR source-field proposals.
population_absence review shows the current complete run plus prior accepted source observation; no fabricated current row is displayed.
disappearance review is never presented as delete/archive/finalize/purge authority.
proposal_view: show exact source family/run/candidate chronology/profile and row locator or population-absence evidence mode
show immutable target/business identities before descriptive text
show typed before/proposed values and why risk is low/medium/high/blocked
show current target state separately from proposal snapshot; stale state disables acceptance and offers refresh/reconsider flow
accept/reject/defer are explicit per-proposal actions; bulk action first presents complete eligible/stale/high-risk/blocked classification and never silently skips
rejected/deferred source presence stays visible in import history
rfc_terminal_state: terminal proposal clearly distinguishes accepting provider terminal evidence from executing local cascade
accept confirmation states that a pending cascade will be created but Tasks/Objectives/Communications will not yet change
after acceptance provide navigation to the RFC pending-cascade impact/hold surface owned by LLD-03/LLD-10
wfm_plan_state: provider source plan, accepted operational Task plan, Objective envelope and actual execution are displayed as distinct labelled facts
source acceptance and operational-plan decision are separate actions
Complete/Plan Cancel are historical/cancelled provider evidence and never shown as proof of SOMA execution/outcome
an unresolved competing-attempt review does not fabricate retry lineage
recovery_state: equal-chronology/different-content and older-source cases use a dedicated high-risk recovery surface
show current checkpoint versus candidate chronology/fingerprint and exact review fingerprint
older-source recovery states explicitly that checkpoint chronology will not move backward
reject/defer/authorize-correction are distinct and stale recovery previews cannot submit
accessibility: state/risk never relies only on color
exact counts remain readable without loading every row
large lists use deterministic keyset paging/virtualized presentation without hiding unresolved conflicts
auto_accept_presentation: The mutation auto-accept registry is empty for Beta 1.0. Replay/no-change may be handled automatically because they perform no operational-domain mutation; the UI shall not expose a misleading ticket-import mutation auto-accept toggle.
